status: local-reviewed-case; not a real contest submission

pdf.visual_review_note: All pages rendered; contact sheets reviewed, with full-size checks of the summary, proof, algorithm box, user guide and appendix. This is an AI layout review.

extension_checks.what: independent RK45 replay of the optimized schedule; schedule water above the energy lower bound

scope: Textbook-correlation scenario coefficients with ranges (order-of-magnitude anchors, not a calibration); constrained temperatures checked on three meshes; no bath experiment; no claim of award, full transcript or independent human review

template_review.summary_hierarchy: Three-column problem/summary/control-number block precedes title and abstract
template_review.year_handling: Year omitted for historical demo: official current sample comment says 2027 but visible heading says 2026

publication_scope: Curated historical case; report, reproduction sources and presentation assets only

extended_analysis.schedules: 3-, 6- and 12-segment piecewise-constant, multi-start SLSQP with constraints checked every 5 s, local optima
extended_analysis.execution_tolerance: uniform scaling, 200 random 10%/20% segment errors, one-segment +/-20%, buffer price at 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3 C on 6 segments
extended_analysis.mesh_check: reproduce/run_mesh_check.py: 12-segment schedule replayed on three meshes and the 6-segment schedule re-optimized on 12 x 6 x 4
extended_analysis.jet_zone: ceiling and spread apply outside a 0.15 m radius around the inlet cell; the floor applies to every cell

independent_audit.finding: the first version's ceiling and spread were not mesh-converged (inlet-cell point source); limits redefined outside a jet zone and all results recomputed
independent_audit.other_changes: coefficient wording, deeper-bath and convective-layer scenarios, tolerance reported as distances

float_callout_review.method: Numbered LaTeX references plus explanations at their associated arguments; PDF text heuristic checks presence, not semantic support.
